latest.notes: Fixes the player freezing when the internet drops. Root cause: the Live365 stream encoder had no backpressure. When the uplink goes half-open (network dies but the socket isn't reset yet), sends stop draining while the encoder kept copying ~43 audio buffers a second onto an unbounded queue and kept calling send() without waiting — memory climbed until the pressure stalled the audio render thread and the playhead froze mid-song. Streaming is now strictly best-effort: the hand-off queue is capped (~0.75s) and only one send is allowed in flight, so a dead uplink DROPS stream audio instead of freezing the station. Local playback is now independent of the internet.
